title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect | TechCrunch
summary: It mandates that large frontier developers — companies with more than $500 million in annual revenue — have to publish safety frameworks on their websites, report critical safety incidents within 72 hours, and issue public model transparency reports.
